title: 第15章 第三位弟子第16章 鸿蒙练体诀
slug: 付费才能修仙我的宗门全免费
content_zh:
苏白缓步走了过来，当他看见肖岩身边还有一位少女时，微微顿了顿。
越来越有意思了！
“仙师，您来了？”
突然，肖岩看到了苏白，脸上顿时露出兴奋的笑容，快步跑了过去。
“我来看看到底是谁！”
看到肖岩迎上去，曦儿也是将目光望了过去。
只见在不远处，一个俊朗非凡，丰神如玉的白袍少年站立。
少年背负着手，一袭月白色长袍，腰缠玉带，身躯挺拔，衣袂飘摇，给人一种出尘脱俗，宛如谪仙临尘的感觉。
其嘴角噙着笑意，眼眸似星河璀璨，清亮透彻，犹如夜空繁星点缀其中。
好一个少年谪仙！
“影叔，看看他什么修为？“
她在心中默念着，不知道跟谁在说话。
片刻之后，她脑海之中，浮现出一道苍老的声音：“小姐，老夫......看不透其修为。”
“什么，影叔您都看不透？”
她瞪圆了眼睛。
影叔的实力，她再清楚不过了。
虽然在她的家族里算不上多强大，但在这大赵帝国，那绝对是站在巅峰的存在！
影叔都看不透，那这个天道宗的宗主，到底是什么实力？
“影叔，天道宗的信息查到了吗？”她继续问道。
“查了，整个仙盟，都没有关于天道宗与苏白的信息，大赵国的几百个大大小小的宗门，也没有天道宗的信息，这个天道宗，仿佛是凭空冒出来的一般。”

影叔沉吟了一番，缓缓道。
“凭空冒出来的？”曦儿诧异道。
想到这，她对苏白更加怀疑了。
肖岩的体质问题，她让影叔悄悄查了，可什么结论都没有得到。
如果影叔都不知道，那么整个大赵帝国，都不可能有第二个人清楚！
即使知道，那实力之强，不可能没有记载！
“仙师，这是我的族妹肖曦儿，她也想前往天道宗，仙师您看？”
肖岩看向苏白小心翼翼的道。
苏白扫了肖曦儿一眼，心中一切明了，淡淡的点了点头。
“既然想去，那便去吧！”
闻言，肖岩脸上露出喜悦，急忙拜谢道。
“多谢仙师！”
随后，一行三人，启程前往天道宗。
不，准确的说，是一行“四”人。
路上，苏白一直背负双手，神色平静，肖曦儿一直盯着他，可都无法看出什么。
这家伙，到底是真有本事还是伪装的？
如果不是肖岩还在此，肖曦儿甚至忍不住想要出手试探其实力了！
天道宗距离云水城并没有多远，不多时，一行人已经到了天道宗的山脚下。
“这就是天道宗？”
看着天道宗的规模，肖曦儿的神色越来越怀疑了。

因为无论怎么看，这天道宗都不像是什么大宗门，充其量不过是一个杂牌宗门罢了！
天道宗，诸葛风与萧灵汐都在等着苏白归来，见苏白带着两个人回来，不由得露出了兴奋的表情。
“师尊，这是新的师弟师妹吗？”
萧灵汐眨巴着美丽的大眼睛，惊奇道。
content_en:
Su Bai walked over slowly. When he saw a girl beside Xiao Yan, he paused slightly.
It’s getting more and more interesting!
"Master Immortal, are you here?"
Suddenly, Xiao Yan saw Su Bai, an excited smile appeared on his face, and he ran over quickly.
"Let me see who it is!"
Seeing Xiao Yan approaching him, Xi'er also looked over.
Not far away, I saw an extraordinary handsome and jade-like young man in white robe standing.
The young man has his hands on his back, wearing a moon-white robe and a jade belt around his waist. His body is tall and straight, and his clothes are swaying, giving people a feeling of being transcended from the world, like a banished immortal coming to the earth.
There was a smile at the corner of his mouth, and his eyes were as bright as the stars, clear and transparent, just like the stars in the night sky.
What a young man who banished an immortal!
"Uncle Ying, look at his cultivation level?"
She thought silently in her heart, not knowing who she was talking to.
After a moment, an old voice appeared in her mind: "Miss, I...can't see through his cultivation."
"What, Uncle Ying, you can't even see through it?"
Her eyes widened.
She knew only too well the strength of Uncle Ying.
Although she is not very powerful in her family, she is definitely at the top of the Zhao Empire!
Even Uncle Ying can't figure it out, so what kind of strength is this leader of Tiandao Sect?
"Uncle Ying, have you found the information about Tiandao Sect?" she continued to ask.
"After checking, there is no information about Tiandao Sect and Su Bai in the entire Immortal Alliance. There is no information about Tiandao Sect in the hundreds of large and small sects in the Great Zhao Kingdom. This Tiandao Sect seems to have appeared out of thin air."
Uncle Ying pondered for a while and said slowly.
"It came out of nowhere?" Xi'er asked in surprise.
Thinking of this, she became more suspicious of Su Bai.
She asked Uncle Ying to investigate Xiao Yan's physical condition quietly, but she couldn't get any conclusion.
If Uncle Ying doesn’t know it, then no one in the entire Zhao Empire knows it!
Even if he knew it, it was impossible for his strength not to be recorded!
"Master Immortal, this is my clan sister Xiao Xi'er. She also wants to go to Tiandao Sect. What do you think, Master Immortal?"
Xiao Yan looked at Su Bai and said cautiously.
Su Bai glanced at Xiao Xi'er, knowing everything in his heart, and nodded lightly.
"If you want to go, then go!"
Hearing this, Xiao Yan showed joy on his face and hurriedly thanked him.
"Thank you, Master Immortal!"
Afterwards, a group of three people set off for Tiandao Sect.
No, to be precise, it was a group of "four" people.
On the way, Su Bai kept his hands behind his back and looked calm. Xiao Xi'er kept staring at him, but she couldn't see anything.
Is this guy really capable or is he just pretending?
If Xiao Yan wasn't still here, Xiao Xi'er couldn't help but want to test his strength!
Tiandao Sect was not far from Yunshui City. Not long after, the group had arrived at the foot of Tiandao Sect's mountain.
"Is this the Tiandao Sect?"
Looking at the scale of Tiandao Sect, Xiao Xier's expression became more and more suspicious.
Because no matter how you look at it, this Tiandao Sect doesn't look like a big sect, it's just a miscellaneous sect at best!
Tiandao Sect, Zhuge Feng and Xiao Lingxi were all waiting for Su Bai to return. When they saw Su Bai coming back with two people, they couldn't help showing excited expressions.
"Master, is this the new junior brother and sister?"
Xiao Lingxi blinked her beautiful big eyes and said in surprise.
